SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'SYN' AND TABLE_NAME LIKE '%STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER%'

SELECT DISTINCT
CUST_NBR
,ISNULL(CUST_CIF_NBR,'') AS CUST_CIF_NBR
,CUST_LOCAL_NAME
,CUST_ENG_NAME
,CUST_ADDR1
,CUST_ADDR2
,CUST_ADD_CITY
,CUST_ADD_PROVINCE
,CUST_ADD_ZIPCODE
,CUST_PHONE
,LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR,CUST_DTE_BIRTH),6) AS CUST_DTE_BIRTH
,CUST_MADDR1
,CUST_MADDR2
,CUST_MADD_CITY
,CUST_MADD_PROVINCE
,CUST_MADD_ZIPCODE
,CUST_CNAME
,CUST_CPHONE
,CUST_ADDR3
,CUST_ADDR4
,CUST_MADDR3
,CUST_MADDR4
,CUST_EMAIL_ADDR
,CUST_MOBILE_PHONE
,CUST_FIRST_NAME
,CUST_MIDDLE_NAME
,CUST_LAST_NAME
,CUST_EMAIL_ADDR2
,CUST_EMAIL_ADDR3
,CUST_PHONE_CTY
,CUST_PHONE_AREA
,CUST_MOBILE_CTY
,CUST_MOBILE_AREA
,CUST_OFFICE_CTY
,CUST_OFFICE_AREA
,CUST_TITLE
,CUST_DATE_MAINT
,BNK_CODE AS BANK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,NULL AS TABLE_NAME
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER A
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CRDACCT_CUST_NBR,CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP WHERE ISLATEST = 1 ) B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
WHERE A.ISLATEST = 1 
    AND A.CUST_LOCAL_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND A.CUST_FIRST_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND A.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND A.CUST_LAST_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND ((B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TES%' 
    AND B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TST%' 
    AND B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%') OR B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR IS NULL)



SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP  
WHERE ISLATEST = 1 AND
CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TES%' AND
CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TST%' AND
CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%'
